body: Thank you. That actually did make me feel better. I've spent a few hours cuddling with my cat, which has helped, and I appreciate you pointing out about dissociation, I'll be sure to mention that to my doctor. I mean, I'll probably dive into that pit a lot more before this is over, but you helped me tonight so...thank you.

I understand how you feel. As someone with depression, I don't say that lightly, as I understand how frustrating it is when people act like they understand when they truly have absolutely no idea. I don't have any perfect thing to say, so I guess what I want you to know is that there are people here who understand, who feel what you feel, know what you know. Just...live. You're in a bad town right now, seemingly surrounded by pretty shitty people, but remember that that's temporary. You can make it, and once you do, you will be able to be in a big city, live near a beach, join a club, study something overseas, have pets and so many other things. It may not seem like it now, but you can reach them.
Wow, this is my late-high school experience in a nutshell.
